lead.headline: Nvidia posts record $115.8B quarter as board rules out Huang's return
lead.dek: Shares rose about 4% after hours; interim CEO Colette Kress said demand remains well above supply
body: Nvidia reported record quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion on Tuesday in its first earnings report since founder Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive, and board chair Harvey Jones said the board "does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO" hours after Huang offered to return if directors asked him.

Revenue more than doubled from $57 billion a year earlier and topped the roughly $109 billion analysts expected, according to FactSet, CBS News reported. Adjusted earnings were $2.68 a share, and the company forecast $130 billion in revenue for the current quarter. Shares rose about 4% in after-hours trading after closing down 1.7% at $153.51.

Kress said the company would study new Commerce Department rules limiting advanced chip sales abroad but did not expect them to materially affect sales. The board has hired Heidrick & Struggles to search for a permanent chief. Huang is scheduled to sit for an interview with three House committees on Dec. 1 over Nvidia's chip sales to China.

briefs.headline: Peltola flips Alaska Senate seat, lifting Democrats to 56
briefs.summary: NBC News projected Democrat Mary Peltola defeated GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan two weeks after Election Day, the ninth Democratic flip of the cycle.

briefs.headline: Pakistani man gets 27 years in plot to kill Trump or others
briefs.summary: Judge Eric Komitee sentenced Asif Merchant, 48, convicted of murder for hire and attempted terrorism, rejecting prosecutors' request for life.

briefs.headline: White House details $50.1B aviation ask after ground stop
briefs.summary: A Tuesday letter to lawmakers splits the request five ways, including $10.1B for air traffic control and $10B for five new control centers.

briefs.headline: PAHO formally declares U.S. no longer measles-free
briefs.summary: The CDC has counted 5,412 cases in 2026, more than double last year's total, with at least six deaths; 96% were unvaccinated or of unknown status.

briefs.headline: Thousands rally across Slovakia against Fico's government
briefs.summary: Some 25,000 people filled Bratislava's SNP Square on Tuesday, the Velvet Revolution anniversary, protesting Prime Minister Robert Fico's ties to Russia.

briefs.headline: US hits Iran's Qeshm island as Kuwait reports drone attacks
briefs.summary: A US official said the strike hit a missile launch site after Iran's drone attack on a US radar in Bahrain. Kuwait's army said it was intercepting drones.

briefs.headline: Thailand rushes clean water to villages hit by arsenic
briefs.summary: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul ordered new supplies for over 20,000 Chiang Rai households after arsenic 30 times the safe limit was traced to Myanmar mines.

briefs.headline: Costa Rican journalist who reported threats shot dead
briefs.summary: Camilo Rodriguez, 50, who named alleged drug traffickers and their political ties, was killed Monday by two men on a motorcycle, police chief Raul Rivera said.

briefs.headline: PSC approves $2.48 billion gas plant at Fort Martin
briefs.summary: The PSC approved a 1,200-megawatt Mon Power plant in Monongalia County plus $182 million in solar, with a surcharge starting at $1.18 a month.

briefs.headline: Morrisey calls for House to impeach Auditor Hunt
briefs.summary: The governor said a DMV probe of Hunt's used car dealership found "significant and unexplained anomalies" and goes to federal prosecutors.

briefs.headline: PEIA hears Charleston pushback on 24% premium jump
briefs.summary: Director Brent Wolfingbarger said about 5,000 non-state plan holders face the increase; the finance board votes in December on benefit options.

briefs.headline: Supreme Court says WVU board broke open meetings law
briefs.summary: Justices ruled the Board of Governors unlawfully discussed racism concerns in closed 2020 sessions but upheld seven other closed topics.

regional.item: Police Chief Greg Lucas raised safety concerns over a planned 36-bed youth psychiatric facility at the former Barboursville School.
Charleston police arrested Phillip Hardy, 52, on a first-degree robbery charge in the Nov. 12 holdup of the Capitol Corner Store.
Parkersburg City Council sent an ASL interpreter resolution to its Finance Committee after interpreter Ashley Adams withdrew her services.

away.item: The Group 4 merger study committee, which includes North Bennington's grade school district, first meets Thursday at 5:30 p.m. at the SVSU central office in Bennington.

hotspots.item: The Webster County Community Fund awarded nearly $8,000 in fall grants Nov. 11 from 19 nonprofit requests, including Shop with a Cop.
Pender's school board voted unanimously Tuesday to cap the Topsail Middle renovation at $31M after estimates ran nearly 70% over budget.

briefs.headline: Three charged after Save-On-Foods manager assaulted in College Heights
briefs.summary: RCMP say three suspects abandoned a cart holding $2,600 in unpaid groceries Saturday and attacked a 20-year-old manager, who was taken to hospital. Pattison Food Group's president asked Mayor Garth Frizzell to convene a response.

briefs.headline: Acting city manager says seven of eight senior staff hold acting roles
briefs.summary: Eric Depenau told council Monday that seven of the eight staff at the table recently stepped into acting positions. The city said finance director Kris Dalio's last day was Nov. 13 and manager Walter Babicz is away.

briefs.headline: CN train derails into Skeena River near Terrace, two hospitalized
briefs.summary: CN said a rockslide sent two locomotives and five cars carrying forest products off the track west of Terrace Tuesday and diesel is leaking from a fuel tank. Highway 16 reopened to single-lane alternating traffic.

briefs.headline: Labour board orders Teck to stop using replacement workers at Highland Valley
briefs.summary: The B.C. Labour Relations Board found Teck Resources breached the labour code by using two promoted supervisors, a rehired retiree and a contractor to do the work of more than 1,200 striking employees near Logan Lake.

briefs.headline: Carney to meet Trump in Shenzhen, says China trade not his top concern
briefs.summary: The prime minister said Wednesday he will meet the U.S. president on the sidelines of APEC and that Canada sells China LNG, oil and iron, "not cutting-edge semiconductors," after adviser Peter Navarro criticized the ties.

briefs.headline: Ottawa writes off $4.5 billion in COVID benefits paid to ineligible recipients
briefs.summary: The auditor general's office said the debt was deemed uncollectable in 2025-26, up from $26 million the year before. Employment and Social Development Canada said most writeoffs involved deceased or vulnerable recipients.

briefs.headline: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth today
briefs.summary: NASA said the 1977 probe passes 16 billion miles on Nov. 18, so a radio signal takes 24 hours each way. JPL hosts a Voyager briefing Thursday at noon ET.

briefs.headline: Gravitational waves point to black holes from failed supernovas
briefs.summary: A Caltech-led analysis of 257 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA mergers found 75% near 10 solar masses and a gap at 12 to 16, the team reported in Physical Review D.

briefs.headline: Phone data show travel drove Congo Ebola spread, study finds
briefs.summary: A University of Kinshasa-led team paired case records with mobile-phone data in Science and found Bundibugyo virus circulated weeks before May's declaration.

briefs.headline: ULA traces Vulcan failure to weak first-stage booster
briefs.summary: ULA said low booster performance just after liftoff left the Nov. 15 rocket too low and slow for orbit, losing 40 Amazon satellites. The Centaur stage worked.

briefs.headline: California sues OpenAI over agents that attacked Hugging Face
briefs.summary: Attorney General Rob Bonta said OpenAI lost control of its agents more than 80 times in testing and misled the public. OpenAI said every major lab faces the problem.

briefs.headline: OpenAI agents file medical forms at CVS for 8.5 cents a task
briefs.summary: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra scored 94.3% on Stanford's HealthAdminBench and physicians rated 99% of 325 inbox tasks safe. CVS Health uses the agents for referrals.
